credit_line: Gift of Peter Stein, Fred Stein Archive
description: Vertical portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe sitting at her dining room (plywood) table at Ghost Ranch looking at the camera with one hand on the table and the other resting on her thigh; her hair is pulled back in a bun and she is wearing a black wrap dress (with a white wrap dress underneath) and her Hector Aguilar suede and sterling silver belt; visible behind her is a curtained window with a partial view of the red rock cliffs that surround Ghost Ranch.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
